name: Week 37 Push — Lateral Raise and Rope Pushdown Take the Spotlight
description: Press first, dips second, the same loads. The DB lateral raise and the rope pushdown share the spotlight; the pushdown runs at 42.5 on the rope pulley. The dips keep the 2-second pause at the bottom. The warmup rotates thread-the-needle to arm circles; Yuri's band work and the protective shrug stay.

dayOverview.theme: Same order and loads. The lateral raise and the rope pushdown get the spotlight; the dips keep their pause at the bottom.

spotlights.why: The 20s for 15-18, wider and slower. Width and the hold at the top are the progression, not a heavier pair.
42.5 on the rope pulley for 12. Elbows pinned, shoulders down, and the squeeze at the bottom is the rep.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: Spotlights go to the strict press and the incline press next.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: strict DB press, dips, incline DB press, Kinesis fly, straight-arm pulldown, farmer carry. Effort here means the cue holding at a hard load; the ceiling is the rep the cue breaks.
🔥 near-failure last set OK: DB lateral raise, rope pushdown, cable lateral raise. Isolation work where form holds at the limit.
**⭐ THE STRICT PRESS GOES FIRST.** If a busy gym forces it late, run it as a push press and use leg drive rather than discovering mid-set that you cannot strict it.
**Do Yuri's band warmup in full before the first press.** It is the push-day shoulder anchor.
**The light curl in the warmup is for the left arm.** Left first, light, nowhere near failure. A twinge that does not clear, or one that is sharper than before, means skip it today.

**Rope pushdown: 42.5 on the rope pulley, 62.5 if you are on the cable column. Pack the shoulders down before every set. A tingle or a zap means stop that set.** The lean-back tricep at 70 is the fallback.
**Dips stay second.** V bar or the parallel bars, whichever is free. Set the rotated left palm before rep 1.
**Take the full 2 minutes on the press, the dips and the incline.** The dips' pause only survives three sets with the full rest.
**Incline: a bench whose seat tilts up with the back.** If none is free, take the barbell or the chest press machine.
**Pack DOWN, not up** on every pressing lift. Blades into the back pockets, neck long, traps quiet. A rep that needs a shrug is over.
**The cable block is three moves.** Straight-arm pulldown, rope pushdown, cable lateral raise, two rounds, minimal rest between them.
**Carry: 60 if the hands feel good, 50 if you are ready to go home.** No straps either way.
Mention any change in either shoulder.

sets.name: Warmup + Shoulder Rehab (Non-Negotiable) + Chest Opener + Protective Shrug
sets.notes: The whole block, every push day. Yuri's band work is the shoulder anchor — it is why the right shoulder has stayed quiet through a heavy pressing block, so it does not get skipped on a short morning.

exercises.notes: Big, slow circles, forward then back. **Shoulders stay down while the arms go round.** Wakes the whole shoulder before the press.
**The shoulder anchor.** Full sequence, light band, no rushing. Cuff first, then scap.

Light bell, inverted. **Wrist stacked over elbow over shoulder** — the bell tipping is the feedback. It rehearses the exact packed-down lockout the press is about to ask for, and the press is the very next thing you do.

**Light DBs, left arm first, nowhere near failure.** Upper arm still at the ribs, slow down. The left arm wants frequency, and this is one more easy dose of it. **Skip it today if a twinge does not clear or is sharper than before.**
Tight fists, thumbs tucked, hinged slightly forward. Wakes the deep core — the press needs the trunk before it needs the shoulders.
Elbows ~45°, **pack down not up.** One easy set.
Greasing set, nowhere near failure. Keeps the pattern alive on a push day.
**Protective activation — before anything loaded.** 40-50lb pair, behind the back, straight up and down.

sets.name: Strict DB Press — 50, First Lift of the Day 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 50lb pair, 3 sets of 8-10. **2 minutes between sets, reps as singles.**

- **No dip, no knee bend, no hip drive.** The set ends when strict form ends
- **Ribs DOWN**, elbows slightly in front of the ribs
- **Pack DOWN, not up.** If the shoulders climb to finish a rep, that rep was the last one

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 50lb pair, 3 sets of 8-10. 2 min rest, reps as singles.
- **Strict — no leg drive, no knee dip**
- Press slightly around the head; biceps near the ears at lockout
- Shoulders packed **DOWN**, ribs down
- If the rack forces this late in the day, run it as a push press instead

sets.name: Dips — Second, 3s Down, 2s Pause at the Bottom 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** bodyweight, 3 sets of 10-12. **V bar or the parallel bars, whichever is free.** 2 minutes between sets.

- **Rotate the left forearm outward before taking bodyweight.** Set it before rep 1
- **3 seconds down, then 2 seconds still at the bottom** — no bounce, no sink
- **Shoulders down and back in the pause**; shorten the set rather than the pause

exercises.notes:
Bodyweight, 3 sets. **V bar or the parallel bars. 2 min rest.**
- Set the rotated left palm **before** the first rep
- **3s down, 2s still at the bottom**
- Hold the forward lean
- Shoulders packed down in the pause and at lockout

sets.name: Incline DB Press — 60, 3s Eccentric 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 60lb pair, 3 sets of 8-12, 3s lowering, 2 minutes between sets. **If the DBs are taken: barbell 50/side (145 total), same reps and tempo. If no bench with a tilting seat is free: the chest press machine, 150 then 170, 10 reps.** Log which version.

- **Bench at 30° with the seat tilting up with the back**, glutes on the pad
- **Blades DOWN and BACK into the bench** before the bells leave the thighs
- **Lower for a full 3 seconds** to a real stretch across the chest

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 60lb pair, 3 sets. **If the dumbbells are taken:** barbell 50/side. **If both are taken, or no bench tilts its seat:** the chest press machine, 150 then 170, 10 reps.
- 30° bench, seat tilted with the back
- **3s lowering every rep**
- Blades down and back, ribs down
- 2 min rest

sets.name: 🔆 DB Lateral Raise — 20, Wider and Slower 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 20lb pair, 3 sets of 15-18. If the 20s are taken, the 15s for 20 reps — same width, same tempo.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — width, not weight.**

- **Traps relaxed before the first rep.** The rep starts at the elbow, never with a shrug
- **Lead with the elbows**, a fixed slight bend, pinkies level with the thumbs
- **Out wide, up to shoulder height** — reach for the side walls, not the ceiling
- **1-second hold at the top**, then 2-3 seconds down
- **The middle-of-the-set burn is the work.** The set ends when the shoulders start to shrug or the arms come forward

**Reflection:** on the last set, which ended it — the burn, or the shoulders creeping up?

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 20lb pair; if the 20s are taken, the 15s for 20 reps.
- **Wide**, reach for the side walls
- Slow up, **1s hold**, slow down
- Lead with the elbow, fixed slight bend
- **Traps relaxed** — no shrug to start the rep

sets.name: Kinesis Cable Fly — 9, Step Far Forward 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** Kinesis 9, 3 sets of 10-12.

- **Step far forward** — the step makes the stretch
- **Soft elbows at a fixed angle**, blades down and back
- Slow into the stretch, a beat there, squeeze at the midline

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** Kinesis 9, 3 sets.
- **Step far forward** into the stretch
- Soft elbows at a fixed angle
- A beat in the stretch, squeeze at the midline
- Blades down and back

sets.name: Cable Block — Straight-Arm Pulldown → 🔆 Rope Pushdown → Cable Lateral Raise (2 Rounds)
sets.notes:
**Two rounds, circuit style, minimal rest between the three moves.** All three live on the cable stations — take whichever is free and stay there. Log the equipment and number for each.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the rope pushdown: elbows are the hinge, nothing else moves.**

- **Upright, facing the stack.** No lean either way
- **Elbows pinned to the ribs** the whole rep; only the forearms move
- **Shoulders packed down before every set**, and they stay down as the arms straighten
- **Split the rope at the bottom and squeeze** for a beat at the hips
- **Slow back up** to just below the chest
- **A tingle or a zap means stop that set**

**Reflection:** did the elbows stay pinned on the last reps of round 2, or did the shoulders start helping?

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:**
- Cable column: **120**
- Rope pulley: **62.5**
- Kinesis: **6**
Pick whichever is free; **note the equipment and number in the log.**

- **Set a soft elbow bend and never change it** — if the elbow opens and closes, it has quietly become a triceps pushdown
- **Start the rep by pulling the upper arm down from the armpit**, not by pushing the hands
- Finish with the hands at the thighs, **lats squeezed, ribs down**
- **No leaning back to add range** — the torso angle is fixed too
- Slow return to a real stretch

**LOAD:**
- Rope pulley: **42.5**
- Cable column: **62.5**
Pick whichever is free; **log the station and the number.** 10-12 reps, both rounds.

- **Upright, facing the stack**
- **Elbows pinned to the ribs**
- **Pack the shoulders down** before every set
- Split the rope and **squeeze at the bottom**, slow back up
- **A tingle or a zap means stop that set.** The lean-back tricep at 70 is the fallback

**LOAD:**
- Cable column: **~30**
- Cable pulley + D-handle (ankle height): **10**
- Kinesis: **3**
Pick whichever is free; **note the equipment and number in the log.**

- **Cable behind the body**, arm crossing in front at the bottom — that is the reason to do it on a cable
- **Lead with the elbow**, stop at shoulder height
- **No shrug**
- Last set may run near failure — 🔥 safe isolation work

sets.name: Farmer Carry — 60 or 50, Your Call at the Handles 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD: 60lb per hand if the hands feel good, 50 if you are ready to go home.** 2 walks of ~50s. **No straps.**

- **Crush the handles from the first step**
- **Shoulders packed down**, ribs stacked over hips, walk tall
- The job is two walks that both hold, not a heavier bell
- If the left goes early, set them down, rest, and finish the time

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 60 per hand, or 50. No straps. **Log which.**
- **Grip hard from the first step**
- Shoulders down, ribs stacked, tall posture
- Two walks that hold beats a heavier bell

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block
sets.notes: Five minutes, every gym day. Slow breathing throughout — the downshift is as much the point as the tissue.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress.
30s each side.
45s each side.
Slow breathing. End here.

tips: Press first, dips second. Take the full 2 minutes on the press, the dips and the incline.
Dips: 3 seconds down, 2 seconds still at the bottom.
Lateral raise: wider and slower on the 20s; the hold at the top is the work.
Rope pushdown: 42.5 on the rope pulley, 62.5 on the column. A tingle or a zap means stop that set.
Light curl in the warmup: left first, nowhere near failure.
Carry is 60 or 50 by how the hands feel. Log which one you took.
